name: ResourceTec Corporation
summary: ResourceTec Corporation is primarily engaged in mineral exploration within the Republic of Indonesia, concentrating its efforts on the development of gold mines. The company possesses stakes in two significant land parcels located in North Sulawesi, part of the Indonesian archipelago: the Ratatotok South property, which extends over approximately 8.6 hectares, and the Ratatotok Southeast property, covering around 14.7 hectares. While currently operating under the name ResourceTec Corporation, the entity was previously known as Borneo Resource Investments Ltd. until its formal name change in April 2025. This company was established in 2009 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
